subject: Co-sell marketplace demo — scheduling and owner alignment
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>
To: Lina Park <lina@cloudforge.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood-inference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood-inference.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Co-sell marketplace demo — scheduling and owner alignment

Hi Lina —

Thanks again for agreeing to a joint marketplace demo with CloudForge + Redwood. We want to lock a 60-minute slot that covers: 1) quick partner intro (5m), 2) customer-facing demo (35m), 3) brief Q&A and next steps (20m). Proposed windows next week (Pacific):

- Tuesday 2026-11-09 10:00–11:00 PT
- Wednesday 2026-11-10 13:00–14:00 PT

If neither works, please share two times that suit Rajiv and the AWS marketplace reviewer (we should include them for the listing questions). I attached the runbook (runbook-v2.pdf) with proposed attendees and roles — Marissa (host), Karthik (tech lead), Vanessa (ops).

Quick asks:
- Can you confirm Rajiv and an AWS contact are available for at least 30 minutes of the demo?
- Any special checklist the AWS team needs before the demo listing review?

Appreciate it — looking to finalize by EOD Friday so we can book the marketplace listing slot.

Best,
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Sr. Partner Sales | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com

---
Attachments: runbook-v2.pdf (application/pdf, 230KB)
From: Lina Park <lina@cloudforge.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Rajiv Menon <rajiv@stratussys.com>, AWS Marketplace <aws-marketplace@amazon.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T11:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Co-sell marketplace demo — scheduling and owner alignment

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the options. Rajiv is tied up the morning of the 9th but is free on 11/10 at 13:00 PT. AWS Marketplace asked if we could start 10 minutes earlier on that day (12:50 PT) to give them time to check listing metadata before we begin the customer demo — would that be possible for your team?

Also noted a couple of items in the runbook (doc comments):
- We should confirm which CI/CD integration screenshot we plan to show (CloudForge has two flows).
- Please mark who will own the recording/asset post-demo — AWS prefers a single owner for the marketplace listing.

If 12:50 start is tight, Rajiv proposed 11/10 15:00–16:00 PT instead.

Thanks,
Lina Park
Partner Ops | CloudForge
lina@cloudforge.io
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>
To: Lina Park <lina@cloudforge.io>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood-inference.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T08:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Co-sell marketplace demo — scheduling and owner alignment

Lina —

Thanks for the quick reply and for flagging the AWS ask. We can make 11/10 work but 12:50 start pushes our customer availability a little. Two options from our side:

- We start 11/10 at 12:50 PT and compress the intro to 3–4 minutes (fine if everyone agrees)
- Move to 11/10 15:00–16:00 PT (Rajiv option) — this preserves full agenda.

Karthik, Vanessa — any constraints on the 15:00 slot?

For the recording: Redwood can own the recording and provide the trimmed 12–15 minute highlight clip for the marketplace listing unless CloudForge prefers to own it. We'll mark the ownership in the runbook.

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood-inference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>, Lina Park <lina@cloudforge.io>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood-inference.com>, AWS Marketplace <aws-marketplace@amazon.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T10:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Co-sell marketplace demo — scheduling and owner alignment

Marissa / Lina —

I can do 11/10 15:00–16:00 PT without issues and prefer that so we don't compress the customer segment. Vanessa — can you confirm the recording ownership and whether Ops will publish the highlight clip to the shared drive? If Redwood owns the recording we will:
- Record with local tracks
- Upload raw recording to GDrive (private folder)
- Produce 12–15m highlight and drop into the marketplace asset folder

Vanessa, please see attached MOP (cosell-mop.xlsx) — contains the checklist we follow for marketplace submissions. Lina — if CloudForge wants ownership instead, confirm and we'll flip the recording owner field.

Proposed final: 11/10 15:00–16:00 PT, Redwood owns recording and will deliver highlights within 3 business days. Confirm?

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Partner Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

---

Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood-inference.com>, Rajiv Menon <rajiv@stratussys.com>, AWS Marketplace <aws-marketplace@amazon.com>
Date: 2026-11-03T15:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Co-sell marketplace demo — scheduling and owner alignment

Confirmed — thank you. 11/10 15:00–16:00 PT works for Rajiv and the AWS reviewer. CloudForge is happy for Redwood to own the recording and produce the highlights. Lina to-do: I will share the preferred CI/CD flow (screenshot + short note) by EOD 11/06 so Karthik can slot it into the demo.

See you all then — adding the calendar invite now.

Best,
Lina
Partner Ops | CloudForge
